Task: Create the MVP workspace and isolated local stack
Acceptance 1: Required repository boundaries and doctor/local lifecycle scripts exist and reject missing prerequisites honestly.
Acceptance 2: Local edge, API and ciphertext stores run under isolated names on loopback with synthetic identities.
Acceptance 3: Local and CI configurations cannot acquire production secrets, call paid suppliers or join real meetings.

Task: Lock and build desktop, API and meeting artifacts
Acceptance 1: Actual runtime, package, native, browser and model versions are resolved into checked-in locks and source inventories.
Acceptance 2: Three server images and the reference desktop payload have computed artifact digests tied to the source revision.
Acceptance 3: Builds reject missing or mutable inputs and images perform no package, browser or model download at runtime.

Task: Generate canonical MVP contracts and protocol vectors
Acceptance 1: Generated client/server schemas implement the same identifiers, lossless integers, typed failures and finite bounds.
Acceptance 2: Duplicate members, unknown critical fields, malformed sizes and invalid operation bindings reject before execution.
Acceptance 3: Signature, encrypted record and channel vectors cover tampering, wrong binding and replay across the native and API implementations.

Task: Create native installation keys and the restricted desktop bridge
Acceptance 1: Reference-platform installation creates its identity and vault key, seals them natively and exports only the public identity for setup.
Acceptance 2: Typed bridge operations enforce origin, window, owner, argument and size checks without arbitrary path, execution or signing access.
Acceptance 3: Lock and same-installation reopen work on the actual reference machine without UI key export or plaintext key files.

Task: Open and verify the attested owner channel
Acceptance 1: Client verifies the expected C01 application, accepted code/configuration and endpoint key binding before releasing the vault key.
Acceptance 2: Authenticated operations travel inside the bounded encrypted channel with owner/session/operation binding and expiry.
Acceptance 3: Wrong application/image/key, replay, altered ciphertext and expired sessions fail before content or secret delivery.

Task: Bootstrap C01 applications and scoped sealed service secrets
Acceptance 1: API and meeting applications have separate accepted identities, explicit OS/image policy and verified attested recipients.
Acceptance 2: Trusted bootstrap transfers complete scoped credential sets without plaintext shell arguments, files, logs or infrastructure state.
Acceptance 3: Service credentials survive approved restart under application seals while no persistent owner vault root enters server secret storage.

Task: Persist encrypted revisions and transactional document commits
Acceptance 1: D01 schema stores encrypted private payloads and only documented opaque transactional metadata with restricted roles.
Acceptance 2: Immutable revision insert, expected-parent CAS and operation deduplication yield one durable result under retry and crash.
Acceptance 3: Stale parent preserves the client draft and missing referenced ciphertext is reported unavailable rather than acknowledged as a saved revision.

Task: Persist encrypted local drafts and pending operations
Acceptance 1: Native drafts and pending operation bytes are encrypted before local database, journal or temporary-file writes.
Acceptance 2: Restart retries the original immutable operation identity and retains an unresolved edit without silently overwriting it.
Acceptance 3: Locked or missing native seal produces an explicit locked/unavailable state without a plaintext fallback.

Task: Deliver upload, file preview and immutable replacement versions
Acceptance 1: Owner uploads supported text PDF, TXT and Markdown within canonical quotas, reopens the retained original and uses Edit as page for TXT/MD with source provenance.
Acceptance 2: Ciphertext chunk manifests resume safely after interruption and reject changed, reordered or oversized bytes.
Acceptance 3: Safe preview and explicit replacement create immutable versions; filenames or plaintext preview URLs never reach ordinary storage or edge logs.

Task: Deliver the persisted rich-text page editor
Acceptance 1: Owner creates and edits a validated structured page using the supported blocks and saves a full immutable revision.
Acceptance 2: Closing and reopening the application restores the page and encrypted unsaved draft correctly.
Acceptance 3: Stale-parent save returns the documented conflict while preserving both accepted revision and local work.

Task: Extract supported documents in a bounded protected process
Acceptance 1: Selected PDF and text parsers run inside C01 without network, general secrets or unbounded CPU/memory/temp access.
Acceptance 2: Extraction stores encrypted chunks tied to exact source revision and page/block locators with canonical size/count limits.
Acceptance 3: Malformed, scanned-without-text, oversized and failed inputs produce explicit coverage/error states without an ordinary-host fallback.

Task: Retrieve selected sources and open exact citations
Acceptance 1: Pinned E02 artifacts and lexical retrieval run in the protected runtime and persist encrypted source-scoped index payloads.
Acceptance 2: Only selected permitted revisions enter bounded context and partial/missing extraction is reflected in retrieval results.
Acceptance 3: Citations open the exact retained revision and locator; source deletion invalidates retrieval before dispatch/publication while newer or unavailable sources remain explicit.

Task: Implement the protected I01 request and response adapter
Acceptance 1: Selected I01 route performs its supported model, attestation/channel/key and response checks without plaintext fallback.
Acceptance 2: Stock request preparation keeps its response-key closure only in protected memory; exact buffered response and verification follow the canonical adapter contract.
Acceptance 3: Malformed proof/output, timeout or crash losing the key cannot trigger a second paid request; answer_lost retains only encrypted evidence for read-only reconciliation.

Task: Implement owner credits, reservation and settlement transactions
Acceptance 1: Lossless owner-bound balances, immutable events and unique purchase/action keys preserve the accounting equations.
Acceptance 2: admitAction reserves the maximum atomically; settleAction releases or consumes it once; concurrent requests cannot overspend.
Acceptance 3: Unknown external outcomes retain their documented exposure and reconcileAction cannot create a second charge or silently record zero cost.

Task: Prepare the real private credit purchase and wallet signature
Acceptance 1: P01 prepares the fixed pack on one configured supported route and durably binds the quote, purchase and original owner.
Acceptance 2: Desktop displays the exact payment details and obtains the documented owner-wallet intent signature without custody of the wallet key.
Acceptance 3: Wrong route, asset, recipient, intent, expiry or changed quote rejects before submission and sensitive provider references remain encrypted.

Task: Submit and reconcile private purchases with one credit
Acceptance 1: Submission persists its identity and send-start state before the external request; ambiguous results use read-only status reconciliation.
Acceptance 2: Authenticated accepted SUCCESS is checked against the original purchase and required actual provider outcome fields.
Acceptance 3: Duplicate, concurrent and restart status observations credit once under unique settlement/purchase constraints; failed or unknown purchases do not credit.

Task: Account for operator supplier capacity and uncertain expense
Acceptance 1: Operator can securely record actual manual prefunding and supported balance/report evidence for the dedicated supplier account.
Acceptance 2: Paid admission checks confirmed usable capacity minus committed or unknown exposure and blocks on low or stale capacity.
Acceptance 3: Retail service debit, owner credits and provider expense remain distinct; missing provider cost stays unknown without inventing or changing an owner balance.

Task: Deliver one bounded paid contextual chat end to end
Acceptance 1: Selected stored revisions produce a protected cited answer through one admitted bounded I01 request.
Acceptance 2: Encrypted status/history exposes reservation, final debit and useful partial/failure states without leaking prompts or provider credentials.
Acceptance 3: Interrupted or uncertain send preserves its action identity and cannot silently resubmit, double debit or use unselected sources.

Task: Build and isolate the single-run meeting attendee image
Acceptance 1: Separate C01 worker boots the locked browser, private display/audio daemon and recorder with the browser sandbox enabled.
Acceptance 2: Worker receives only run-scoped recording/control authority and no owner vault root, historical content or merchant/inference credentials.
Acceptance 3: Browser profile, display and audio temp data remain inside protected bounded scratch with no host mounts, public debugging or plaintext log output.

Task: Implement authorized guest admission and stop controls
Acceptance 1: Owner authorizes the pasted meeting URL and session cap, with reservation accepted before the visible guest attempts entry.
Acceptance 2: Guest-enabled host admission, timeout, denied entry and unsupported login/CAPTCHA follow the canonical visible states.
Acceptance 3: Stop and the bounded reconnect path preserve one run identity and distinguish requested stop, confirmed leave and uncertain external state.

Task: Capture encrypted meeting audio with truthful timing
Acceptance 1: Actual private sink samples produce independent five-second encrypted FLAC chunks with verified sample format, counts and timing.
Acceptance 2: Chunk ordering, partial tail, silence and capture gaps survive interruption and authenticated upload without fabricated coverage.
Acceptance 3: Spool, duration and recording caps stop new capture safely while retaining acknowledged encrypted chunks and explicit partial state.

Task: Transcribe protected audio with checkpointed provenance
Acceptance 1: S02 loads only pinned model artifacts and processes verified recording chunks in constrained C01 subprocesses.
Acceptance 2: Timestamped transcript segments preserve original sample-clock coverage and explicit gaps with bounded checkpoints and deadline.
Acceptance 3: Malformed audio, resource exhaustion and worker restart preserve completed encrypted output and never route audio to an ordinary speech endpoint.

Task: Commit, reopen and query the saved meeting transcript
Acceptance 1: Canonical recording import commits the recording-key-wrapped artifact metadata using expected revision without a competing storage type.
Acceptance 2: Saved transcript reopens with correct temporal citations, supports text-only revision edits, and cascades audio/key cleanup on deletion with quota released after verified removal.
Acceptance 3: Contextual questions use selected transcript coverage and report missing/gapped audio honestly; summaries require their own admitted chat action.

Task: Settle the capped meeting session and recover partial runs
Acceptance 1: Session reservation precedes join and bounds admitted attendance plus eligible captured-audio usage under the canonical price profile.
Acceptance 2: Stop, denied admission, cap exhaustion and partial transcription settle or reconcile the original action once with documented units.
Acceptance 3: Worker crash or uncertain leave never becomes invented captured audio, a blind replacement run or a zero-cost assertion.

Task: Deliver credit purchase, balance and usage screens
Acceptance 1: Owner can prepare/sign a pack purchase and see pending, success, failure or uncertain status from the encrypted API.
Acceptance 2: Account view distinguishes available and reserved credits with immutable purchase/debit history and meaningful action states.
Acceptance 3: Repeated refresh/reopen reconciles the original purchase without prompting duplicate payment or exposing private merchant/provider metadata.

Task: Unify the desktop library, editor, chat and meeting experience
Acceptance 1: Installed client supports navigation across the same owner's stored files, native pages, transcripts, contextual chat and credit screens.
Acceptance 2: Empty/loading/locked/conflict/partial/uncertain states preserve user work and link to the relevant source or action.
Acceptance 3: One continuous local synthetic journey completes upload, edit, reopen, cited answer, meeting transcript and payment-to-debit UI paths.

Task: Exercise deterministic crash, replay and failure boundaries
Acceptance 1: Faults at durable commit, send-start and response milestones preserve original operation/purchase/action identities.
Acceptance 2: Tampered/replayed channels, interrupted uploads, malformed files, duplicate payment status and worker failures produce documented safe states.
Acceptance 3: Evidence distinguishes pass, fail, blocked and skipped with exact fixtures/source/configuration, and fixtures cannot enable live external actions.

Task: Configure opaque ingress, least privilege and content-free diagnostics
Acceptance 1: Public paths are limited to canonical runtime/session/channel/health surfaces and bounded ciphertext transport, with private methods inside encryption.
Acceptance 2: D01/O01 roles, bucket privacy, validated TLS, egress allowlists and actual proxy limits match the canonical contracts.
Acceptance 3: Logs, metrics, health checks and diagnostics omit content, meeting URLs, credentials, private payment data and plaintext body snippets.

Task: Deploy the immutable demo candidate to actual C01
Acceptance 1: Actual supported node/OS/application selection and observed API/worker images match the rendered immutable candidate.
Acceptance 2: Wrong application/image/key/debug configuration fails the live negative checks before synthetic content-key or service-secret delivery.
Acceptance 3: Migrations, private object behavior, resource caps, scoped secrets and content-free health pass on the demo environment with recorded evidence.

Task: Package and install the signed reference desktop build
Acceptance 1: Bundled reference-platform artifact carries the intended signature and matches its recorded payload/build digest.
Acceptance 2: Actual reference machine installs, launches, creates native keys and reopens saved encrypted work using the demo configuration.
Acceptance 3: Selected-file/native-store permissions and restricted bridge/CSP behavior pass without remote application code or unnecessary capture permissions.

Task: Verify encrypted backup, retention and ordinary restore
Acceptance 1: Backup inventory contains ciphertext application payloads and sealed service envelopes with the declared seven-day expiry.
Acceptance 2: Isolated restore verifies schema, referenced objects and secret-envelope availability without persisting an owner vault root.
Acceptance 3: Uncertain purchase and paid-action states reconcile before paid dispatch resumes; missing artifacts remain unavailable rather than silently reset.

Task: Inspect the actual deployment for plaintext canary leaks
Acceptance 1: Unique synthetic document, prompt, transcript, meeting URL and secret markers are absent from ordinary logs, D01/O01 exports and backups.
Acceptance 2: Inspection covers actual edge/host temp paths, browser profiles, parser/speech scratch, crash output and diagnostic collection.
Acceptance 3: The evidence records inspected surfaces and encrypted exceptions; any plaintext leak blocks that candidate's demo acceptance.

Task: Prove a real private purchase and subsequent paid chat
Acceptance 1: Authorized owner executes the real fixed-pack P01 purchase and authenticated actual SUCCESS is bound to the original purchase.
Acceptance 2: Repeated reconciliation and restart produce exactly one credit with the transaction and unique settlement evidence retained privately.
Acceptance 3: One actual protected cited chat reserves then settles its service debit from that credited account, with supplier expense separately recorded or honestly unknown.

Task: Prove actual authorized meeting audio through saved transcript
Acceptance 1: Authorized host admits the visible guest in the recorded qualified meeting configuration and real spoken test phrases are captured.
Acceptance 2: Saved audio-derived transcript has truthful timestamps/gaps and a contextual answer cites an actual transcript interval.
Acceptance 3: Owner stop produces recorded terminal attendance/capture status and bounded settlement with private evidence tied to the actual candidate.

Task: Complete the installed MVP demo and evidence readback
Acceptance 1: Same installed candidate completes upload/store/view/version, native page create/edit/save/reopen and selected-source contextual chat.
Acceptance 2: Evidence includes the real purchase credited once, a subsequent paid chat debit and an actual authorized meeting transcript/question journey.
Acceptance 3: Redacted report binds desktop/images/source/configuration to every result and leaves missing evidence as Not run, blocked or failed rather than declaring success.
